notes:
{腐敗|ふはい} can refer to either physical decay (rotting) or moral/political corruption.

WRITING:
- {腐|ふ} (rot, decay, spoil)
- {敗|はい} (defeat, fail, deteriorate)

USAGE:
- {腐敗|ふはい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to decay, to become corrupt - suru verb)
- {腐敗|ふはい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧〜 (decayed ~, corrupt ~)

SENSE 1 (Physical decay):
- {腐敗|ふはい}{臭|しゅう} (smell of decay)
- {腐敗|ふはい}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (decay prevention)
- {腐敗|ふはい}{菌|きん} (decay bacteria)

SENSE 2 (Corruption):
- ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧{腐敗|ふはい} (political corruption)
- {腐敗|ふはい}⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧ (corrupt politics)
- {腐敗|ふはい}⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧ (corrupt nature/structure)
- {腐敗|ふはい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{官僚|かんりょう}→官僚：02780_kanryou⟧ (corrupt bureaucrats)

PROVERB:
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腐敗|ふはい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (Power corrupts - from Lord Acton's dictum)
